categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Changes txindex lookup error handling in src/index/txindex.cpp to detect database iterator errors.
categories.rationale: Prevents txindex lookups from silently reporting a transaction as missing when underlying database reads or corruption fail. In this category, returning wrong answers silently is a primary data integrity concern, and author testing confirmed that disk corruption resulted in a false nullopt lookup rather than raising an error.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: The additions to src/dbwrapper only expose a CheckStatus helper for the index query without altering validation invariants or chainstate behavior.
categories.rationale: Non-member: PR primary subject is an optional index in src/index/, and the minor method addition in dbwrapper does not alter validation logic.
